notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Hello !

A few QoL bug fixes and 4 missing achievements.

[list]
[*]Hit registration should now be much better, especially against several enemies at once.
Eventually got a work around and hopefully it won't be an issue anymore.
[*]Collision detection should be more robust. Also improved many collision boxes, especially for small objects (ex: rocks in the raider stronghold)
[*]Last palace level has a new route, hopefully removed any game breaking soft lock.
[*]4 New achievements, [spoiler]for the bosses added some time ago in 1.2.0.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Thank you for reading and see you next time !

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello,

Small fix about controllers, 
I appreciate the bug reports and all kind of feedback!

-Fixed an issue with multiple controllers connected.
-Re-added joystick support, you should be able to use both the D-pad and/or joystick.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have been working on this update for a while, and it's now released!

Welcome to patch 1.2: 
Added 4 new bosses:
-Scorpion King (which moves the Giant Spider to another level)
-Skeleton King
-Sheri and Lucy, the twin witches
-Final boss has a whole new visual too!

Added new cutscene art and 2 new portraits for the twin witches.
Added a new area, completely remade marshes.
New art for the mushroom and its attack.
Several new visual effects.
Heavier weapons have a 3rd swing.
Tweaks to block puzzles.
Reworked how doors function.
Other under the hood bug fixes.

New patch isn't compatible with older save files, 
it needs to be played on a new game save.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

First content patch :D

[list]
    [*]Added a new segment in the sewers
    [*]Added a new monster.
    [*]Added a new new boss.
    [*]Added a new range weapon, a flammable projectile. 
    [*]Fixed a puzzle reset issue in the sewers.
    [*]Hopefully fixed some of the knockback bugs.
    [*]More under the hood code for possible more bosses.
[/list]

Both new monster and boss are spawning in the new segment.
The boss has a chance of dropping one star weapons.
The new flammable weapon appears later in the game.


Cheers~

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Another patch, trying to polish the game and iron out some issues !

[list]
    [*]Added some healing particle effect, will work on this one a bit more.
    [*]Added some invincibility frames for the jump attack.
    [*]Boss is a bit tougher and his spell requires a bit more dodging.
    [*]Reworked some of the enemy code, including a line of sight and an aggression value, overall it should feel a bit better.
    [*]Better hitboxes for all weapons.
[/list]

Cheers~

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Thanks for the support and the feedback!

A small but needed first patch :
[list]
[*]Added left stick controller support.
[*]Hopefully fixed the softlock when using bow and the throwing axes.
[*]Made a few hitboxes tweaks for the dagger, mace and axe, so when swarmed you might be able to hit something.
[/list]

I'll continue fixing the most important issues first, then I'll look into adding content and suggestions :D
